Question 9

Find the domain of the function f(x,y)=xyx2+y2.

a
{(x,y)∈R2:x2+y2≥1}
b
The domain is the entire xy-plane
c
{(x,y)∈R2:x2+y2≠0}
d
{(x,y)∈R2:x2+y2<2}
e
{(x,y)∈R2:x2+y2=0}
